subject: Request: Temporary Net-75 billing pilot for Acuvera Health
messages:
From: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@acuvera.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Roberto Diaz <roberto.diaz@acuvera.com>
Date: 2026-08-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Request: temporary Net-75 billing cadence for Q3

Hi Mateo —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the usage numbers against our Q3 cash flow plan and need to ask whether Redwood can support a short-term billing cadence change: a pilot that moves Acuvera to Net-75 for invoices issued in Aug–Oct (three invoices, one quarter). The ask is driven by an unexpected reimbursement delay from a key payer.

Quick details:
- Approx monthly spend: $120k (see attached usage snapshot)
- Proposed billing: Redwood invoices monthly but payment terms Net-75 for the next three cycles
- No change to pricing or SOW; this is purely a payment timing concession

We understand this is non-standard and are open to providing a partial upfront payment or an escrow arrangement if that helps. Can you loop in whoever handles credit/policy and let us know what information you need?

Attachments: Acuvera_Usage_Snapshot_Q2.csv, Acuvera_payment_request_summary.pdf

Appreciate any flexibility — Marta
Director of Strategic Ops
Acuvera Health
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-11T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary Net-75 billing cadence for Q3

Team — forwarding Acuvera's ask. Short summary: enterprise prospect (close to contracting) is requesting a 3-month Net-75 pilot because of a payer timing gap. They remain committed to the contract and usage.

Why this matters now:
- This is a $1.44M ARR run-rate account (est.) once ramped — big logo and reference opportunity
- Legal says no pricing change; this is payment timing only

Immediate asks:
1) Karthik — can you run a quick credit + revenue recognition impact? If revenue recognition requires deferral we need to know how this impacts year-end.
2) Laura — any standard language or guardrails you want in an amendment?
3) Jonas — can we get conditional leadership signoff to run a 90-day Net-75 pilot with criteria?

I suggested they might do a 25% upfront retainer as a good-faith option — Marta is open to that but prefers to avoid large prepayments.

I'll keep Acuvera in the loop but will mark this as pending exec review.

— Mateo
Account Exec, Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-11T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary Net-75 billing cadence for Q3

Mateo / team —

I reviewed the attached usage snapshot and ran a quick credit scenario. Concise notes:
- Credit risk: low-to-medium given Acuvera's series B status and our reference-check results, but exposure over 3 months (~$360k) is material to collections. Recommend a hard credit limit and weekly receivables check.
- Revenue recognition: if we invoice monthly and payment is Net-75, ASC 606 considerations mean we still recognize revenue when control transfers (usage billed). However, if they request invoice timing adjustments (quarterly vs monthly) we may need to assess contract modifications. For Net-75 alone, revenue deferral is not automatic but we should coordinate with accounting.
- Suggested guardrails: 1) 90-day pilot (Aug–Oct) 2) 25% deposit for the first invoice OR ACH mandate with senior signatory 3) Weekly AR checkpoint, 4) Exit clause: revert to standard Net-30 if any payment is >30 days late after due date.

I think this is a reasonable commercial concession given the strategic upside, but we should escalate to Jonas for final approval on deposit/exposure limits and signoff on the exit clause.

Attachment: quick-credit-snapshot (internal)

— Karthik
Head of Revenue Ops
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: mateo_alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-12T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary Net-75 billing cadence for Q3

Thanks for the diligence. I approve a conditional Net-75 pilot for Acuvera for three billing cycles with the following mandatory controls:

1) 25% good-faith deposit on the Aug invoice (applies to the first invoice only).
2) ACH mandate and CFO signatory on the payment terms amendment.
3) Weekly AR checks owned by Revenue Ops; any invoice aging >30 days triggers automatic reversion to Net-30 and in-person escalation.
4) Legal to prepare a one-page amendment that includes the exit clause, no pricing changes, and a firm end date (Oct 31, 2026).

Karthik — set a $400k exposure ceiling for the pilot. If Acuvera requests anything beyond these guards, route to me for final exec review. Mateo — communicate these terms back to Marta and copy me. Laura — can you draft the amendment by EOD tomorrow?

Jonas
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
